title: Search scan is quadratic: project_sessions re-reads all session metadata per project
description: pj search _scan_sessions called fs_store.project_sessions once per project; each call walks every session's metadata (603 projects x 6300 sessions = 3.8M stat-heavy calls). close_reason: Two quadratic paths in search scan removed (be86122, d5abdb4). Bridge searches: no-hit/selective >90s 504 -> 2-3s; scan portion of hit searches 26s -> 1.5-4s. Remaining bridge latency is LM Studio classifier (~1.7s per uncached 4KB chunk, no gain from parallel workers).

title: pj index refresh [--verify] and pj index status CLI commands
description:
## Objective

Add a `pj index` subcommand (engineering #1, CLI first; decision 2026-10-17):
- `pj index refresh [--verify]` runs `fs_index.refresh(verify=...)` and returns its result.
- `pj index status` reports path, exists, bytes, schema_version (and whether it matches), indexed file count, dirty file count (stat only, no parsing), `built_at`, and FTS5 availability.
Both use the same JSON envelope and `--pretty` handling as the other pj commands.

Fixed shape (do not choose another):
- `index` uses nested subparsers: `sub.add_parser("index").add_subparsers(dest="index_action", required=True)`, so `--verify` exists only on `refresh` and `pj index status --verify` fails loudly. (`census` uses a positional `choices=` action instead; do not copy that here.)
- Status logic lives in `fs_index.status() -> dict`; the CLI wraps results in `envelope.ok(...)`.
- Mirror `_cmd_ports` (pj/cli.py ~590): `--pretty` prints only on success; otherwise print `envelope.to_json(env)` and `sys.exit(1)` on error.

description:
## Objective

`fs_index.refresh()` creates or updates the SQLite file at `index_path()`:
schema per plan (meta with `schema_version`, `files`, FTS5 trigram `messages`),
one row per message holding the text fs_store's content search sees.
Searches still delegate to fs_store in this task.

## Context

- Files:
  - `pj/fs_store.py` `search_content` (~line 296) - message text source: `parser.parse_session(path).messages`, `_configured_roots()`, `parser.list_sessions(root)`, `parser.parse_metadata(path)`, `_activity_ms`

## Scope

Schema detail (fixed; do not merge these): `parse_metadata` and `parse_session` disagree on title, workspace and timestamps (metadata reads head/tail lines; codex picks titles differently). So `files` stores the metadata fields (`title`, `session_id`, `workspace`, `started_at`, `ended_at`, `activity_ms`; `activity_ms = 0` and the rest NULL when `parse_metadata` returns None) and, separately, the `parse_session` fields (`s_title`, `s_session_id`, `s_workspace`, `s_started_at`, `s_ended_at`). If FTS5 is missing, `refresh()` raises `RuntimeError` naming FTS5.
Out: answering searches from the index; write-back from searches; verify mode.

title: Decide remote exposure and auth policy
description:
## Objective

Choose and record the security policy for using the census server as a host-side service reachable from disposable Docker/yolobox sandboxes. The decision must cover reads, annotation writes, control endpoints, token names, and behavior for non-loopback binds.

## Context

- Source: `docs/plans/pj-sandbox-agent-access.md#security-and-safety-rails`
- Files:
  - `pj/census_server.py` - current HTTP routes and unauthenticated annotation POST handling
  - `pj/census_process.py` - background server lifecycle and control token handling
  - `README.md` - documented web API contract and web UX maintenance rules
  - `tests/test_census.py` - existing endpoint tests
- Discovery:
  - `rg "PJ_CENSUS_CONTROL_TOKEN|annotations|do_POST|do_GET" pj/census_server.py pj/census_process.py`
  - `rg "GET /api|POST /api|web API contract|annotations" README.md`
  - `rg "annotation|control|health|search endpoint" tests/test_census.py`
- Scratchpad/plan: `docs/plans/pj-sandbox-agent-access.md`

## Scope

In:
- Decide whether all non-loopback serving requires auth.
- Decide whether reads and writes use separate tokens.
- Decide whether annotation writes are disabled remotely by default or gated.
- Decide how unsafe `pj census serve/start --host 0.0.0.0` behaves.

Out:
- Implementing the policy in code.
- Designing remote annotation writes beyond the minimum safe exposure rule.

## Rationale

Record a short rationale for the chosen policy. It must explain why the policy is safe for browser users, sandbox agents, and non-loopback host exposure while preserving `PJ_CENSUS_CONTROL_TOKEN` for stop/control behavior.

## Alternatives Considered

Record at least these alternatives and why they were accepted or rejected:
- Loopback remains unauthenticated; non-loopback requires read auth.
- Separate read and write tokens.
- Read-only remote mode with annotation writes disabled outside loopback.
- Single shared token for all non-control endpoints.
- Refusing non-loopback binds unless explicit auth/config is present.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The decision is written into this plan or a linked ADR/decision section.
- [ ] Token names and header format are specified.
- [ ] Loopback versus non-loopback behavior is specified.
- [ ] Annotation write behavior is specified separately from read behavior.
- [ ] Rationale and alternatives considered are recorded.
- [ ] Downstream implementation tasks no longer need to choose a security model.

## Testing

- Documentation-only task; no test command required.
- Optional sanity check: `rg "PJ_READ_TOKEN|PJ_WRITE_TOKEN|Authorization|non-loopback" docs README.md`

## Dependencies

- Blocked by: None - can start immediately.
- Blocks: skill, health, and server exposure implementation tasks.

## Notes

The current control endpoint already uses `PJ_CENSUS_CONTROL_TOKEN`; do not weaken that path. Treat browser, sandbox-agent, and user input as untrusted at the HTTP boundary.
notes: 2026-09-16: Accepted yolobox ADR 0005 supplies policy: private sessions share read-only history without per-query approval; open-internet sessions only explicitly approved immutable history including metadata; legacy defaults private. Older census-as-sandbox-service design is superseded by a separate authenticated read-only facade. Every route requires an expiring host-issued capability; no annotation/control routes; loopback only. Project-juggler owns client/facade/filtering; yolobox owns trusted posture and installation. Current installed yolobox launcher is open-egress/shared-HOME and must receive no private capability. Reconciliation and implementation staged in isolated clean checkout to preserve existing census edits. Activation and final closure require actual installed-boundary evidence.

title: Web UX roadmap

acceptance_criteria: Epic is complete when the dashboard supports search, project detail, next queue, transcript viewing, and annotation actions while preserving full CLI functionality without a server.

title: Add live census dashboard
description: Implement pj census serve as a stdlib local dashboard backed by live pj project data. It should serve the census UI without embedded stale data, expose a JSON endpoint, cache detailed scans, and refresh only when session signatures change.
close_reason: Implemented pj census JSON and live stdlib dashboard server with signature-aware refresh; tests pass.

title: Plain pj search still parses every session on misses (no index)
description: After pj-t1b, unscoped CLI search with few/no hits takes ~50-60s on ~6300 sessions / 3GB because every session is fully parsed. The nono bridge avoids this with an rg prefilter shim (yolobox-pattern example/yolobox-pj-query-server.py _guard_parse). Consider moving an rg/byte prefilter into pj itself.
close_reason: Superseded by pj-8qn (opt-in SQLite index; plan in docs/plans/fs-index.md)
